string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_PACK_AC_M_80A
string.body: Level 80 Wrapping Scroll for Mythic Class - Accessory and Head Armor

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_PACK_WE_M_80A_DESC
string.body:
Allows use of wrappable Mythic weapons below level 80.
Can be traded once afterwards.
Double-click the Wrapping Scroll and select the item you want to wrap.
[Caution]
 1. Acquired wrapped weapons will be automatically unwrapped.
 2. Weapons can be wrapped a set number of times, and each use will unwrap weapon.
 3. Wrapping will remain on acquired weapons that you have previously wrapped. (This includes a canceled auction, receiving an item after an auction has expired, retrieving an item from a personal store, canceling a trade, changing items attached to mail, or sending mail to yourself)
 4. 4. The following items can be wrapped: level 20 items that have an additional wrap after regular enchantments, Manastone Socketing, DP Charge, Add Idian, Modify Appearance
 5. Cannot be wrapped: equipped items, wrapped items, overlapping, combined two-handed weapons, untuned items
 6. While wrapped, weapons cannot be socketed with Enchantment Stones, Manastones, Godstones, or Idian; cannot be charged with DP or magic; dyed or have appearance modified, or have any socketed stones or appearances removed or altered.

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_PACK_AR_M_80A_DESC
string.body:
Allows use of wrappable Mythic armor below level 80.
Can be traded once afterwards.
Double-click the Wrapping Scroll and select the item you want to wrap.
[Caution]
 1. Acquired wrapped armor will be automatically unwrapped.
 2. Armor can be wrapped a set number of times, and each use will unwrap weapon.
 3. Wrapping will remain on acquired weapons that you have previously wrapped. (This includes a canceled auction, receiving an item after an auction has expired, retrieving an item from a personal store, canceling a trade, changing items attached to mail, or sending mail to yourself)
 4. 4. The following items can be wrapped: level 20 items that have an additional wrap after regular enchantments, Manastone Socketing, DP Charge, Add Idian, Modify Appearance
 5. Cannot be wrapped: equipped items, wrapped items, overlapping, combined two-handed weapons, untuned items
 6. While wrapped, armor cannot be socketed with Enchantment Stones, Manastones, Godstones, or Idian; cannot be charged with DP or magic; dyed or have appearance modified, or have any socketed stones or appearances removed or altered.

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_PACK_AC_M_80A_DESC
string.body:
This scroll can be used on a wrappable Mythic class Accessory and Head Armor that is Level 80 and under.
The accessory and armor can be traded just once after wrapping.
Double-click (or right-click) the wrapping scroll and select an item to wrap.
[Caution]
 1. If you obtain wrapped items, they will be automatically unwrapped.
 2. If you equip or use a wrapped item, it will become unwrapped and the number of times you can wrap it decreases.
 3. If you obtain the item again after wrapping it, the wrapping will stay in place. (Cancellation of an auction or receiving an item back after the time on an auction has run out, retrieving an item from a personal store, cancelling a trade, changing or retrieving items attached to mail, and sending mail to yourself)
 4. Wrappable: Normal enhancements, Manastone Socketing, charging DP, charging MP, Idian addition, appearance modification, and items with additional wrapping count added by succeeding in enhancing at least 20 times.
 5. Unwrappable: Items that are equipped, already wrapped, overlapping, combined two-handed weapons, items before tuning.
 6. While they are wrapped, extraction, Enchantment Stone enchantment, Manastone Socketing, Godstone enchantment, Idian addition, DP charge, MP charge, dying and appearance modification, removing Manastone, removing dye, removing auxiliary weapon, and combining two-handed weapons are unavailable.

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_PACK_WI_M_80A_DESC
string.body:
Allows use of wrappable Mythic wings below level 80.
Can be traded once afterwards.
Double-click the Wrapping Scroll and select the item you want to wrap.
[Caution]
 1. Acquired wrapped wings will be automatically unwrapped.
 2. Wings can be wrapped a set number of times, and each use will unwrap weapon.
 3. Wrapping will remain on acquired weapons that you have previously wrapped. (This includes a canceled auction, receiving an item after an auction has expired, retrieving an item from a personal store, canceling a trade, changing items attached to mail, or sending mail to yourself)
 4. 4. The following items can be wrapped: level 20 items that have an additional wrap after regular enchantments, Manastone Socketing, DP Charge, Add Idian, Modify Appearance
 5. Cannot be wrapped: equipped items, wrapped items, overlapping, combined two-handed weapons, untuned items
 6. While wrapped, wings cannot be socketed with Enchantment Stones, Manastones, Godstones, or Idian; cannot be charged with DP or magic; dyed or have appearance modified, or have any socketed stones or appearances removed or altered.

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_DESC
string.body:
You can enchant all applicable functions of the Stigma.
If successful, the level will increase by 1, or with a lower chance of increasing by 2 or 3.
If unsuccessful, the level decreases by 1 or has a lower chance to remain the same.
Double-click (or right-click) the Stigma Enchantment Stone to activate and then select a Stigma to enchant.

string.name: STR_CASH_KISK_LIGHT_PARTY_SMALL_HIDE_01_DESC
string.body:
Summons a Stealth Kisk that lets you resurrect at its location. The Kisk will remain active for 2 hours, allowing up to 6 players use it for a total of 18 resurrections.
Only the summoner's group members can use it.
Detectible with skills like Reveal and Vision.
Stealth Kisk can be seen by the player who summoned it.
Once summoned, it will have the same cooldown as other Kisks.

string.name: STR_INGAME_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_DESC

If successful, the Stigma will increase by 1 level, with a chance to increase by 2 or 3 levels.
If unsuccessful, the Stigma has a chance of decreasing by 1 level.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_MATTER_OPTION_A_PHY_01_DESC

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDINFINITY_ALL_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body: Enables you to acquire the <Champion of the Crucible Spire> title.\nUsing this title increases your Movement Speed by 5%, Attack Speed by 3%, Casting Speed by 3%, and HP by 500.\nCan be used for 7 days.

string.body: Enables you to acquire the <Conqueror of the Crucible Spire> title.\nUsing this title increases your Movement Speed by 4%, Attack Speed by 2%, Casting Speed by 2%, and HP by 300.\nCan be used for 7 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDINFINITY_ALL_TITLE_03_DESC

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDINFINITY_ALL_TITLE_04_DESC

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDINFINITY_ALL_TITLE_05_DESC

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_01_DESC
string.body: I am Graa, the Daeva of Bluffs.\nI used to be a Daeva of Zephyr but then I became the Daeva of Bluffs.\nDo you want to know why?

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_02_DESC
string.body: Last year on April 1st, the Daevas who were sent to search for a Legendary weapon asked me a this:\n"Graa, if we leave the instanced dungeon this time, when will we be able to enter again?"\nSo I told them, "I will give you a quiz. The answer you seek is in the quiz."

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_03_DESC
string.body:
"Firstly."
"How many altars are there in D'maha?"
"Second, what time does the Guardian Deity General battle start?"
"And lastly, how many Stigma slots do Daevas have?"
But those Daevas couldn't even answer these simple questions. They just stared helplessly at the entrance to an instance dungeon that they could've gone into.

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_04_DESC
string.body: After reading this message, you must know the answer. Any Daeva who has ever been in Atreia should know.\nThe answers to the three questions are simple, but I won't simply tell you them, or what rewards await. That would spoil the fun, don't you think?

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_05_DESC
string.body: You can't do it? Then I will give you a hint.\nThe answer is 'time', and my favorite day is April 1st.\nOh, and don't trust my words too much.

string.name: STR_WING_MISSION_PVP_R2_A_78A_DESC
string.body:
Take this item to an Equipment Promoter to promote it to Ultimate Strengthened Wings.
The promotion material, Compact Crystal of Ambition can be obtained in the mission 'Inanna's Decision' for the Elyos, and 'Inanna's Will' for the Asmodians.

Regardless of its enchantment stats, the item becomes promoted to +2 Ultimate Stellin Wings.

string.name: STR_WING_MISSION_PVP_R2_A_78B_DESC
string.body:
Take this item to an Equipment Promoter to promote it to Ultimate Strengthened Mystic Wings.
The promotion material, Compact Crystal of Ambition can be obtained in the mission 'Inanna's Decision' for the Elyos, and 'Inanna's Will' for the Asmodians.

Regardless of its enchantment stats, the item becomes promoted to +2 Ultimate Stellin Mystic Wings.

string.name: STR_WING_MISSION_SUB_PVP_R2_A_80A_DESC
string.body:
Take this item to an Equipment Promoter to promote it to Ultimate Strengthened Wings.
The promotion material, Compact Crystal of Ambition can be obtained in the mission 'Inanna's Decision' for the Elyos, and 'Inanna's Will' for the Asmodians.

Regardless of its enchantment stats, the item becomes promoted to +2 Ultimate Stellin Wings.

string.name: STR_WING_MISSION_SUB_PVP_R2_A_80B_DESC

The promotion material, Compact Crystal of Ambition can be obtained in the mission 'Inanna's Decision' for the Elyos, and 'Inanna's Will' for the Asmodians.

Regardless of its enchantment stats, the item becomes promoted to +2 Ultimate Stellin Mystic Wings.

string.name: STR_MATERIAL_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_A_01_DESC
string.body: A material used for Aetherforging.\nYou can obtain Ancient Alcemium through Aetherforging. There is a low chance of obtaining Ancient Legion Treasure Chest keys.

string.name: STR_MATERIAL_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_R_01_DESC
string.body: A material used for Aetherforging.\nYou can obtain Legendary Alcemium through Aetherforging. There is a low chance of obtaining Legendary Legion Treasure Chest keys.

string.name: STR_MATERIAL_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_F_01_DESC
string.body: A material used for Aetherforging.\nYou can obtain Ultimate Alcemium through Aetherforging. There is a low chance of obtaining Ultimate Legion Treasure Chest keys.

string.name: STR_COIN_LDF5_R_80A_DESC
string.body: A mark that can be obtained in Katalam.\nYou can exchange the mark for the Ultimate Aureate Sky Equipment Box and Legendary Katalam Mark Box through the <Katalam Reward Exchange Officer> at the Ancient Sanctum of Life and Ancient Temple of Wisdom in Lakrum and at Stellusia in Demaha.

string.name: STR_COIN_LDF5_F_80A_DESC
string.body: A mark that can be obtained in Katalam.\nYou can exchange the mark for the Crimson Katalam Equipment Box and Ultimate Katalam Reward Box through the <Katalam Reward Exchange Officer> at the Ancient Sanctum of Life and Ancient Temple of Wisdom in Lakrum and at Stellusia in Demaha.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EXP_COIN_80A_DESC
string.body: A mark that can be obtained by extracting character XP.\nExperience Marks can change the result of disassembling the Legendary Katalam Mark Box and Ultimate Katalam Reward Box. To extract character XP, you need the Experience Extractor, which you can buy at the general stores in Lakrum and Demaha.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_COIN_LDF5_PIECE_R_80A_DESC
string.body: A piece of the Legendary Blood Mark.\nGather the pieces and double-click to assemble them.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_COIN_LDF5_PIECE_F_80A_DESC
string.body: A piece of the Ultimate Blood Mark.\nGather the pieces and double-click to assemble them.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EXP_EXTRACTION_80A_DESC
string.body: A tool required to craft Experience Marks.\nYou can buy it at the general stores in Lakrum and Demaha.\nTo use the tool, character XP must be greater than 175,000,000. When used, it consumes XP and creates Experience Marks.

string.name: STR_RIDE_LDF5_BIKE_GREEN_1DAY_DESC
string.body: Use this to get on and off your mount.\nPress and hold the Vertical Ascent key to activate/maintain the mount's Sprint.\nThis consumes your Flight Time.

string.name: STR_RIDE_LDF5_BIKE_WHITE_3DAY_DESC
string.body: Use this to get on and off your mount.\nPress and hold the Vertical Ascent key to activate/maintain the mount's Sprint.\nThis consumes your Flight Time.

string.name: STR_RIDE_LDF5_BIKE_RED_7DAY_DESC
string.body: Use this to get on and off your mount.\nPress and hold the Vertical Ascent key to activate/maintain the mount's Sprint.\nThis consumes your Flight Time.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF5_REWARD_ALL_TITLE_1DAY_DESC
string.body: Enables you to acquire the <Explorer of Katalam> title.\nUsing this title increases your Movement Speed by 3%%, Attack Speed by 2%%, Casting Speed by 2%%, and HP by 300.\nCan be used for 1 day.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF5_REWARD_ALL_TITLE_3DAY_DESC
string.body: Enables you to acquire the <Explorer of Katalam> title.\nUsing this title increases your Movement Speed by 3%%, Attack Speed by 2%%, Casting Speed by 2%%, and HP by 300.\nCan be used for 3 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF5_REWARD_ALL_TITLE_7DAY_DESC
string.body: Enables you to acquire the <Explorer of Katalam> title.\nUsing this title increases your Movement Speed by 3%%, Attack Speed by 2%%, Casting Speed by 2%%, and HP by 300.\nCan be used for 7 days.

string.name: STR_TRANS_POTION_GRADE05_01_INGAME_DESC

string.body:
A box containing Katalam Protector's Weapons.
Double-click (or right-click) to choose from its contents.
The box disappears when you leave Katalam.
<Guide> You can receive an exclusive quest when the Katalam Protector's Weapon Box is in your inventory (Cube). Check whether you've received the quest before opening the box.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_SAMGYETANG_BOX_01_DESC
string.body:
A Heat Hunter's Ginseng Chicken Soup that increases your stamina.
Double-click (or right-click) to open it.
This box can be used for 7 days.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_JULY_SUMMERHUNTING_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Enables you to acquire the <Heat Hunting> title.
Using this title increases your Movement Speed by 4%%, HP by 200, Attack Speed by 3%%, and Casting Speed by 3%%.
Can be used for 7 days.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_JULY_LAW0717_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Enables you to acquire the <Law-abiding Citizen> title.
Using this title increases your Movement Speed by 5%%, MP by 200, Physical Defense by 15, and Magical Defense by 15.
Can be used for 7 days.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_JULY_CHICKENRIDER_01_30DAY_DESC
string.body:
Cluck! It's a chicken.
Use this to get on/off.
Press and hold the Vertical Ascent key to activate/maintain the mount's Sprint. Consumes Flight Time.
This mount is available for 30 days.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_LDF5_REWARD_TEN_MILLION_QINA_DESC
string.body: A box containing 10,000,000 Kinah.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open.

string.name: STR_COIN_LDF5_TORSO_F_80A_DESC
string.body: A mark that can be exchanged for the Crimson Katalam Jacket Box.\nThere is a chance to obtain it from the Ultimate Katalam Reward Box.\nYou can exchange the Ultimate Katalam Reward Box through the <Katalam Reward Exchange Officer> at the Ancient Sanctum of Life and Ancient Temple of Wisdom in Lakrum and at Stellusia in Demaha.

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_PRIVATE_DESC
string.body: Summons a resurrection Kisk. The Kisk remains for 20 minutes and can be reinstalled after a 1 minute cooldown.\nUsable only by the summoner.\nUsable only in Katalam.

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_PARTY_DESC
string.body: Summons a resurrection Kisk. The Kisk remains for 20 minutes and registers up to 6 players.\nUsable only by the summoner's group members.\nUsable only in Katalam.

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_FORCE_DESC

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_LEGION_DESC

string.name: STR_CASH_CARPET_01_90DAY_DESC
string.body: Use this to mount/dismount. Mounting time is reduced, and HP Recovery is temporarily in effect while on the mount.\nThe recovery is activated/maintained for 30 seconds after mounting. 200 HP and MP are recovered every 3 seconds.\nCan be used for 90 days.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_CARPET_01_90DAY_BOX_DESC
string.body: A box containing Magic Rug - Special Recovery (90 days).\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open.

string.name: STR_EVENT_ITEM_PLAYTIME_RECOVERY_60_DESC
string.body: An item that restores 60 minutes to a Dimensional Hourglass.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to use it.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_TOTALWORLD_PLAYTIME_RECOVERY_30_DESC
string.body: Restores 30 minutes to a Dimensional Hourglass.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to use it.

string.name: STR_TOTALWORLD_PLAYTIME_RECOVERY_60_DESC

string.name: STR_TOTALWORLD_PLAYTIME_RECOVERY_120_DESC

string.name: STR_EVENT_RING_ORIGINAL_01_DESC
string.body: A witch's ring that supposedly brings you love. You can check its grade by taking it to the Appraisal Witch Pamred in Stellusia of D'maha.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_RING_BROKEN_01_DESC
string.body: A witch's pulverized ring. You can sell it to a merchant for Kinah.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_RING_JUNK_01_DESC
string.body: A trophy proving that you have defeated an Ancient Creation.\n The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_RING_ANCIENT_01_DESC
string.body: A witch's ring that supposedly brings you love if used where the S'nua herb is in bloom. Double-click (or right-click) to obtain a special item.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_RING_RELIC_01_DESC
string.body: A witch's ring that supposedly brings you love if used where the Boiling Geyser is pooled most deeply. Double-click (or right-click) to obtain a special item.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_RING_FINALITY_01_DESC
string.body: A witch's ring that supposedly brings you love if used on the Island of Love. Double-click (or right-click) to obtain a special item.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_RING_BRILLIANT_01_DESC
string.body: A witch's brilliant ring that supposedly brings you love if used on the Island of Love. Double-click (or right-click) to obtain a special item.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_EVENT_RING_01_DESC
string.body: A piece of the witch's ring.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ITEM_CASH_MAGICAL_BOOK_TITLE_A_DESC
string.body:
Contains an <Incarnation of War> title.
Use the title to increase Physical Crit by 1,000, HP by 2,000, Attack Speed by 3%%, and Movement Speed by 5%%.
The title can be used for 10 hours.
It will be deleted during the maintenance on September 11, 2019.

string.name: STR_ITEM_CASH_MAGICAL_BOOK_TITLE_B_DESC
string.body:
Contains an <Incarnation of Battle> title.
Use the title to increase Crit Spell by 1,000, HP by 2,000, Casting Speed by 3%%, and Movement Speed by 5%%.
The title can be used for 10 hours.
It will be deleted during the maintenance on September 11, 2019.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_SEVENTHDAY_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Enables you to acquire the <Staying Healthy for Precious Meetings> title.
Using this title increases your Movement Speed by 5%%, Physical Defense by 15, and Magical Defense by 15.
The title can be used for 7 days.
It will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_AUTUMNDAY_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Enables you to acquire the <Soft Autumn Breeze> title.
Using this title increases your Movement Speed by 5%%, Physical Crit by 30, and Magic Crit by 30.
The title can be used for 7 days.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_LIBERATIONDAY_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Enables you to acquire the <Bright Light's Return> title.
Using this title increases your HP by 815, Movement Speed by 5%%, Attack Speed by 2%%, and Casting Speed by 2%%.
The title can be used for 7 days.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_ADD_SOCIAL_FALLEN_7DAY_DESC

string.body: A box containing Ultimate Sovereign's Earrings and Ring. Double-click (or right-click) to choose from its contents.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_MATTER_OPTION_F2_MASTER_BOX_DESC
string.body: A box containing 2 Upgraded Ultimate Manastone Selection Boxes. If you are lucky, you can obtain 100 Manastones.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open it.

string.name: STR_EVENT_PCBANG_SYMBOL_OF_ETERNITY_01_DESC
string.body:
An item necessary to convert temporary PC Café Equipment into a permanent item.
You can also obtain consumables by opening the Mark of Imperishability.
Double-click (or right-click) to open it.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_PCBANG_SYMBOL_OF_ETERNITY_02_DESC
string.body: A fragment of the Mark of Imperishability.\nGather these fragments and double-click them to assemble.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_PCBANG_DEVASKILL_LANDOM_BOX_R_01_DESC
string.body: A fragment of the Legendary Daevanion Skill Box.\nGather these fragments and double-click them to assemble.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_PCBANG_DEVASKILL_LANDOM_BOX_R_01_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_BUSYBEE_SET
string.body: [Event] An Appearance Selection Box for You

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_RAID_PVE_F2_80A
string.body: [Event] Ultimate D'maha Champion Weapon Selection Box

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_RING_HARD_BASE_PVE_F2
string.body: [Event] Ultimate Starlight Flare Ring Selection Box

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_10_ENCHANT_RING_HARD_BASE_PVE_F2
string.body: [Event] +10 Ultimate Starlight Flare Ring Selection Box

string.name: STR_REC_EVENT_CV_MATERIAL_PVP_EVOLVE_F2_80A_DESC
string.body: Teaches the morph substances needed to craft Ultimate Etium.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_GJP_SCROLL_STAMP_01_DESC
string.body: A certificate that can summon the reward for today's activity. It can be used at the Stellusia Main Square in D'maha.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to summon 5 You Did Well Today Boxes and Treasure Chests.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_EVENT_GJP_QUEST_JUNK_01_DESC
string.body: A license to gather invading alien species in Red Katalam.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_BUSYBEE_SET_DESC
string.body: A box containing a Busy Bee Outfit, Busy Bee Head, and Golden Charming Wing Feather.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to choose from its contents.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_NBATTERY_01_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing 3,000 Shards.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to open it.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_RAID_PVE_F2_80A_DESC
string.body: A box containing a D'maha Champion Weapon.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to choose from its contents.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_MAIN_BOX_DESC
string.body: A reward box for today's activity.\nIt is automatically disassembled.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_ASSEMBLY_RING_HARD_BASE_PVE_F2_B_DESC
string.body: A bundle containing 1 to 2 Faint Starlight Soul Stones.\nAssemble the Faint Starlight Soul Stone and Faint Shard of Light Ring to obtain the [Event] Ultimate Starlight Flare Ring Selection Box or obtain the [Event] +10 Ultimate Starlight Flare Ring Selection Box with a low chance.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_RING_HARD_BASE_PVE_F2_DESC
string.body: A box containing a Ultimate Starlight Flare Ring.\nDouble-click (or right-click) it to choose from its contents.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_10_ENCHANT_RING_HARD_BASE_PVE_F2_DESC
string.body:
A box containing +10 Ultimate Starlight Flare Rings.
Double-click (or right-click) it to choose from its contents.
The Enchant Level applies as soon as the item enters the inventory.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_EVENT_GJP_SCROLL_STAMP_01_DESC
string.body: A stamp that praises today's activity.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_RING_HARD_BASE_PVE_F2_B_DESC
string.body: A stone of crystallized power. You can feel the energy of Faint Starlight.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_WRAP_EVENT_GJP_RING_HARD_BASE_PVE_F2_A_DESC
string.body: You can feel the energy of Faint Starlight.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.body: A reward box for today's activity.\nIt is automatically disassembled.\nThe item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.

string.name: STR_CASH_POINTSHOP_KISK_LIGHT_FORCE_MEDIUM_HIDE_01_DESC
string.body:
Summons a Stealth Kisk that lets you resurrect at its location. The Kisk will remain active for 2 hours, allowing up to 24 players use it for a total of 72 resurrections.
Only the summoner's group members can use it.
Detectible with skills like Reveal and Vision.
Stealth Kisk can be seen by the player who summoned it.
Once summoned, it will have the same cooldown as other Kisks. 
The item is not consumed when used.
It can be used for 15 days.

string.name: STR_EVENT_REWARD_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_7DAY_DESC
string.body:
You can enchant all applicable functions of the Stigma.
If successful, the level will increase by +1, with a lower chance of increasing by +2 or 3.
If unsuccessful, the level decreases by 1, with a lower chance to remain the same.
Double-click (or right-click) the Stigma Enchantment Stone to activate and then select a Stigma to enchant.
The item will be deleted at a predetermined time when the event ends.
